name: Vigilant-Class
role: General-purpose fleet escort, screening, interception, anti-piracy, picket duty, convoy protection, independent patrol, and rescue support.
design_doctrine: A Vigilant is built to move ahead of, beside, or behind a high-value formation, detect and intercept threats before they reach the protected asset, and remain capable of independent patrol without becoming a stealth-specialist or capital combatant.
canonical_capabilities: FTL performance sufficient to screen and reposition around a Judicator task group
Extensive reconnaissance, counter-drone, and repair-drone capacity

task_group_assignment.note: Both standing Judicator escort slots use the Vigilant-Class. Replacement requires a later owner-authorized event.

class_boundaries.obsidian_comparison: Unlike the Obsidian-Class stealth destroyer, the Vigilant is a visible, general-purpose fleet escort optimized for sustained screening, interception, convoy protection, and independent patrol rather than black operations or deep-cover reconnaissance.
class_boundaries.aegis_comparison: Unlike the larger Aegis-Class battlecruiser, the Vigilant is not intended to trade capital-ship fire at the center of a fleet engagement.
class_boundaries.vanguard_comparison: The Vigilant is heavier, more enduring, and more formation-oriented than the Vanguard-Class frontier frigate.

staged_specifications.primary_armament_model: Distributed medium plasma-cannon batteries, hybrid kinetic batteries, and modular guided-interceptor cells; exact counts, yields, arcs, and ammunition remain STAGING.
staged_specifications.defense_model: Segmented shields, ablative armor districts, distributed point defense, decoys, and counter-drone systems.
staged_specifications.propulsion_model: Redundant FTL and high-output sublight systems optimized for rapid formation repositioning; exact drive topology remains STAGING.
staged_specifications.embarked_craft_model: A small complement of boarding or rescue cutters, utility shuttles, and mission-configurable drones; exact quantities remain STAGING.
staged_specifications.endurance_model: Capable of extended independent patrol but designed to replenish from fleet logistics during sustained campaigns.

promotion_pass: Judicator Escort and Bulker Class Pass — 2026-07-21; Judicator Task Group Vessel Identity Pass — 2026-07-21
notes: Class identity, role, canonical capability families, and the Watchfire/Shieldwake assignments are owner-authorized CANON. Exact dimensions, complement, weapon counts, drive implementation, and embarked-craft quantities remain STAGING.
